stage.title: Hand-off
stage.about: The leader gives its ballot to the next leader. The next leader does not run Phase 1.

steps.says: Node 0 hands the leadership to node 1. Node 0 is not the leader now.
notes: Node 0 hands ballot 1.0 to node 1, and it stops leading inside the same call, before the message exists. It sends the frontier: slot 1 is the next free slot. It also sends the tail below the frontier: 0 slots already chosen, 0 slots still in flight. The two parts cover the whole range. The successor can therefore skip Phase 1 and still know every slot below the frontier.
Node 0 becomes a follower again. Its rounds are volatile, so they go with the leadership. Nobody re-sends what it had in flight.
